environment.reset: fresh original Gymnasium environment per checkpoint; env.reset(seed=s) for each episode
environment.other_environment_options: unchanged benchmark defaults used by flat baseline training

randomness.per_episode: Python random.seed(s); numpy.random.seed(s); env.reset(seed=s); action_space.seed(s); observation_space.seed(s)
randomness.DreamerV3: agent.rng = numpy.random.default_rng(s) before agent.init_policy(1); native _next_rngs produces JAX policy/planning keys
randomness.TD-MPC2: torch.manual_seed(s), torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(s); t0=True resets MPC carry; cudnn deterministic=True, benchmark=False
randomness.SAC: agent.rng=jax.random.PRNGKey(s); native actor distribution mode is deterministic
randomness.matched_seeds: Matched environment initialization, not identical trajectories across methods

return: Float64/Python-float sum of original per-step environment rewards; no smoothing or replacement

failure.semantics: Native termination if robot root qpos[2]<0.58 OR window_wiping_tool z<0.58; task exposes no separate flag or reason identifying which condition
failure.native_failure: bool(terminated), using native task failure termination directly, including a failure on horizon step
failure.horizon: Gymnasium TimeLimit truncated is recorded separately and is not itself failure
failure.reason: NATIVE_ROBOT_OR_TOOL_HEIGHT_TERMINATION / HORIZON_TRUNCATION; no new detector or state queries
failure.info: record final available info key names and only explicit scalar failure/termination/success fields; never export reward-component/contact/force values
